chosen.title: How To Do A STANDING CABLE HIP ADDUCTION | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide
chosen.description:
The Standing Cable Hip Adduction is an exercise that strengthens the adductor muscles found on the inner thigh. To get started:
1. Connect an ankle attachment to the low pulley on a cable machine, then secure it around the ankle closest to the cable machine.
2. While standing to the side of the cable machine, hold on to the machine with one arm for balance, then take a step away until the cable is tight.
3. Bring your extended leg with the weight across the front of your body.
4. You should feel a good contraction in the inner thigh muscles.
5. Under control, reverse the movement to bring your leg back to the starting point, without allowing the weight to rest.
6. Repeat all the reps on one leg, then switch legs and repeat.

candidates.title: Cable Hip Abduction & Adduction
candidates.description:
The focus of this exercise is engaging your abductors and adductors plus balance. 

Abduction: Set the pulley unit to the setting nearest the floor. Using a small handle or a velcro attachment on the cable machine, place your outside foot in the loop. Take one step off the machine to create space between the attachment and the pulley. Then keeping your hips in a parallel line to the cable, balance on your inside leg as you move your outside foot from the center of your body to as far way from your body as you can control. Then return back to your starting position under control before repeating.

Adduction: Set the pulley unit to the setting nearest the floor. Using a small handle or a velcro attachment on the cable machine, place your inside foot in the loop. Take one step off the machine to create space between the attachment and the pulley. Then keeping your hips in a parallel line to the cable, balance on your outside leg as you move your inside foot from outside of your body to as far across the center line of your body as you can control. Then return back to your starting position under control before repeating.

candidates.description:
Same cable setup, totally different results 👇

▫️ HIP ADDUCTION
→ Targets: Inner thighs (adductors)
→ Form cue: “Pull in — squeeze like crushing a watermelon!” 🍉

▫️ HIP ABDUCTION
→ Targets: Side glutes (glute medius)
→ Form cue: “Push out — open like a clamshell!” 🐚

▫️ GLUTE KICKBACK (HIP EXTENSION)
→ Targets: Glute max (upper + lower)
→ Form cue: “Kick back — push away bad vibes!” 🍑

⚠️ To keep it simple:
• Abduction 👉 Push out — side glutes
• Adduction 👈 Pull in — inner thighs
• Extension 👢 Kick back — whole glutes

💡 Pro tip:
Do all 3 in one circuit (10–15 reps each) — perfect finisher for legs or glutes day!

candidates.title: Cable Hip Abduction: SUMMIT
candidates.description:
1.) Attach the ankle strap to your outside leg – Stand tall with the cable machine to your side.

2.) Hold the machine lightly for balance – Keep core braced and hips square.

3.) Sweep the working leg out to the side – Lead with the heel, not the toes.

4.) Pause briefly at the top – Squeeze the glute med without leaning.

5.) Slowly return under control – Don’t let the weight pull your leg back.

Tip: To isolate glutes better, angle your toe slightly downward during the raise.
Targets: Glute medius, hip stabilizers.
